notes: The floor under the woods (plot 11): at the wood's open side the herb fringe, a strip of tall grass and dry herb stems the plough and the mower leave (in October standing dry); under the mantle and the shrub belt, where the light still comes in from the side, grass in patches; further in, grass only where light comes through, in patches. Measured from the land cover's nearest open cell (edge wood), so the fringe follows every wood's side; the trees' line stands back from it by map_dressing.json's edge_setback_m, so the fringe widens into the bays.
source: game value: sam3d estimate (a natural edge's herb fringe at least 5 m, a 1980s managed edge against ploughland thinner, so 3.5 m; the mantle and shrub belt 10-20 m in practice: Thurgau forestry office, Waldrandgestaltung, and BIO Austria, Waldraender, as in docs/scenery/VEGETATION.md section 1; densities judged by eye at plot 11)
